tools.name: shopwired_get_business
tools.description: Get the ShopWired business account: name, domain, default currency and package. Good first call to confirm which store the key belongs to. ShopWired API: GET /business.

tools.name: shopwired_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first by default. Filter by status id, archived flag or created date range (from/to). Each order has its id, reference, created date, status and tracking URL. ShopWired API: GET /orders.

tools.name: shopwired_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its status, customer, line items and totals. ShopWired API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: shopwired_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by keyword (order reference, customer name or email, and similar). Returns totalItems and the matching orders. ShopWired API: GET /orders/search.

tools.name: shopwired_list_products
tools.description: List products in the store, with name, price, stock and active state. Filter by active flag. ShopWired API: GET /products.

tools.name: shopwired_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its description, price, variations and stock details. ShopWired API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: shopwired_search_products
tools.description: Search products by keyword (name, SKU and similar). ShopWired API: GET /products/search.

tools.name: shopwired_list_customers
tools.description: List customer accounts, with name, email and trade flag. Filter by email or trade status. ShopWired API: GET /customers.

tools.name: shopwired_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer account by id, with contact details, addresses and trade status. ShopWired API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: shopwired_get_stock
tools.description: Get the stock quantity for one SKU (a product or a product variation). ShopWired API: GET /stock.

tools.name: shopwired_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories. Use embed=parents to include each category's parents. ShopWired API: GET /categories.

tools.name: shopwired_list_brands
tools.description: List the active product brands in the store. ShopWired API: GET /brands.

tools.name: shopwired_update_stock
tools.description: SETS the stock quantity for one SKU, or for up to 15 SKUs in one call (items). It replaces the current value; it does not add to it. Check the current value with shopwired_get_stock first. ShopWired API: POST /stock.

tools.name: shopwired_update_order_status
tools.description: CHANGES an order's status, and optionally its tracking URL. When sendEmail is true the customer receives a status email, so only set it on purpose. Status ids come from the store's order statuses. ShopWired API: POST /orders/{id}/status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shopwired_list_orders, shopwired_search_orders, shopwired_list_customers, shopwired_update_stock · Private data: shopwired_get_customer · Public sink: shopwired_search_orders, shopwired_list_customers, shopwired_update_stock, shopwired_update_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shopwired_list_orders, shopwired_search_orders, shopwired_list_customers, shopwired_update_stock · Private data: shopwired_get_customer · Public sink: shopwired_search_orders, shopwired_list_customers, shopwired_update_stock, shopwired_update_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
